name: NIETO ELECTRIC

hero.title: When the power goes out, your home keeps running.
hero.lead: Nieto Electric is a family-owned electrician in Baytown, Texas, installing, maintaining and repairing home standby generators for homeowners, local businesses and property owners across the Baytown and Mont Belvieu area.

highlights.title: Family owned
highlights.text: A local, family-owned company built on trust and expertise.

highlights.title: Licensed professionals
highlights.text: Our licensed professionals handle every project, large or small.

highlights.title: Briggs & Stratton dealer
highlights.text: We are a Briggs & Stratton Authorized Dealer.

highlights.title: Itemized estimates
highlights.text: Our estimates are transparent and itemized, and can be adjusted with different options.

steps.title: On-site assessment
steps.text: After you complete our form, we assess your home and size the right generator for you.

steps.title: Get a transparent, itemized estimate
steps.text: The estimate is itemized and can be adjusted with different options, and once you approve it we move to installation.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: We take care of permits, code compliance, a base for the generator, transfer switches and anything generator related.

steps.title: Future maintenance
steps.text: Once the job is done, we make sure everything is operational and ready for the next outage, with maintenance and our warranty to follow.

reviews.author: Kathy Fielding
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Nieto Electric. Joe installed our new Briggs and Stratton home standby generator and completely new breaker panel. Joe and his team are hard working, fair, and very professional. The quality of work is excellent. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: esther7hadassah
reviews.text: Joe and the Nieto Electric team are very professional and patient. They clearly explained what they would be doing, what issues were found, and how to remedy them. I appreciate the clear guidance and options that were provided. I highly recommend the service Joe and his Nieto Electric team provide.

reviews.author: Connie Dominguez
reviews.text: Joe and Nieto Electric have handled several jobs for me, and I can always rely on them for excellent results. Their work is high quality, done with speed and care, and they are both reliable and knowledgeable. It’s rare to find a company you can fully trust, but Nieto Electric is definitely one of them. Highly recommend!

about.title: A local family business, built on trust and expertise.
text: Nieto Electric is a family-owned company serving homeowners, local businesses and property owners across the Baytown and Mont Belvieu area. We are committed to your safety, comfort and satisfaction.
Our licensed professionals handle every project, large or small. We guide you to the right generator for your home or business and handle the permits.
We are a Briggs & Stratton Authorized Dealer, so you can buy your generator and have it installed through us.
